decision: Retain original cost estimates plus one shared text+length cost option for every frozen quality method; no mean/length-only primary variants.
fees: Encoder singleton fees and CPU/native hosting remain separately accounted; cost model is not assumed free.
method_naming: Original method unchanged; added <method>__textcost, with cost and quality identities separate.
refit: Fresh TRAIN+development TFIDF vocabulary/IDF/length scaling; same fixed log-Ridge objective, tolerances and residual smearing, no new selection.
selection_basis: Declared development normalized dollar MSE selects alpha0.1. Development frontier shows middle-budget gains and high-budget tradeoffs; no claim of universal dominance.
